actualExportReview.helperExportShape: Plain module.exports object; spread retains all current real API function identities except the deliberate startFocusEventMonitor wrapper.
actualExportReview.monitorReturnShape: Plain object: ready promise, stop function, events array, configurable error getter and monitorPid getter. Real stop is closure-based and returns one memoized promise.
actualExportReview.proxyBehavior: ready/events/monitorPid and unknown properties use Reflect.get on actual monitor; stop getter returns one stable wrapper function; real error getter always takes precedence.
actualExportReview.stopBehavior: Call actual monitor.stop immediately once; await its actual returned promise via then; only fulfillment installs the one fixed Error. Preserve real fulfillment value. Memoize the wrapper promise for repeat stop.
actualExportReview.noFakeNativeCallback: Do not call onError, add events, replace ready, change monitorPid or suppress actual failure. If real stop rejects, injection is not installed and rejection reaches actual runner.
